title: Toddler Playing in Sand Outdoors with Mother, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage outdoor snapshot capturing a small toddler sitting on a sandy clearing or riverbank, playing intently. To the right, a woman (likely the mother) stands partially framed in high-waisted, cuffed capri-length trousers and slip-on flats, characteristic of mid-1950s casual fashion. In the foreground, the elongated shadow of the photographer stretches across the bright ground, framed by wooded brush and trees in the background.
